webster.text: Performance of more than duty requires.

example.quote: They say that your rights are secured in the paper on the table, so that these subsequent amendments are a mere supererogation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
